mapper.select: /*AdminBoard_SQL.selectFinshNoticeList*/ SELECT A.NOTICE_ID , A.NOTICE_TITLE , A.NOTICE_EFFECT_GB , A.NOTICE_CN , A.NOTICE_FIX_YN , A.NOTICE_LIMIT_YN , TO_CHAR(A.NOTICE_STR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS NOTICE_STR_DT , TO_CHAR(A.NOTICE_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS NOTICE_END_DT , A.NOTICE_FINISH_YN , A.NOTICE_DEL_YN , A.NOTICE_POP_YN , A.REG_ID , TO_CHAR(A.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT , A.UPD_ID , A.UPD_DT FROM TB_NOTICE_INFO A WHERE 1=1 AND A.NOTICE_DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.NOTICE_LIMIT_YN = 'Y' AND A.NOTICE_END_DT < NOW()

/* AdminSchedule_SQL.selectEndMoimList */ SELECT MOIM_ID , MOIM_TITLE , MOIM_DT , MOIM_MAX_CNT , MOIM_DEL_YN , MOIM_LOCATE_ID , MOIM_CN , MOIM_GB , MOIM_STATUS_YN , REG_ID , REG_DT , UPD_ID , UPD_DT FROM TB_MOIM_INFO WHERE 1=1 AND MOIM_STATUS_YN = 'Y' AND MOIM_DT < NOW() ORDER BY MOIM_DT DESC
